# Bounty

![Bounty](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/bounty.png)

Pays 1 gold for every 2 points it scores.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 40%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 4 points

## Tails
Score 2 points

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Trader](characters-trader)
